PART V  Medical Nutrition Therapy
Route of Nutrition
Although oral diet is the preferred route of nutrition for patients 
with ESLD, anorexia, nausea, dysgeusia, and other gastrointesti-
nal symptoms can make adequate nutrition intake difficult to 
achieve. Early satiety is also a frequent complaint such that 
smaller, more frequent meals are better tolerated than three large 
meals. In addition, frequent feedings may also improve nitrogen 
balance and prevent hypoglycemia. Oral liquid supplements
